reviews.text: R2 Roof Guys replaced my patio cover roof recently.  Richard did a fabulous job!!  It’s way better than it was originally!!  He completed it quickly and his pricing was more than fair.  I would definitely use him again!
reviews.author: Lariann Bowen

reviews.text:
We had roofing gutters and paint done. I must say we’re very pleased with everything  the time and precision of each project . The time it took was only 3 or four days tops,  that is working days. We had to do this project and work around the rain. Everything still went according to the plan Richard laid out. Richard is a great communicator, he kept us informed as to when the roofers / painters Gutters would be installed. Roberto and his painters were incredible as well.  I can’t fail to mention the gutter installers , they made the installation seem so effortless. These people know how to get done very professional, clean was just awesome!
I highly recommend R2 Roof Guys!
reviews.author: Amos Mason

reviews.text:
I contacted Richard about a leak in my roof on a Sunday, and he showed up promptly on Monday to assess my roof. We received his estimate that same night and his crew showed up at 7am on a Thursday the following week to begin work.

Upon removing the shingles from the roof, Richard informed me that the decking and rafters were not laid correctly, and gave me the option to redo them all correctly or just replace the new shingles over the improperly laid decking and rafters. I told him to redo them all correctly.

The crew set off to completely rebuild that part of my roof while Richard came back periodically throughout the day to check on the work.

All the work was completed by 5pm that same day, and Richard sent me photos of the completed roof from different angles, the chimney flashing as well as photos of the decking and rafters before they laid the shingles.

The new roof looks well done and the crew also cleaned up very nicely. Richard and his team were very professional, and everything was explained very clearly to me. If I didn't understand anything, Richard would show it to me.

I am very satisfied with the new roof and my interaction with Richard and his team.
reviews.author: Jane Martin

reviews.text:
I had an outstanding experience with R2 Roof Guys! From the moment I contacted them for a quote to the completion of the roofing project, their service was top-notch. The team was professional, efficient, and extremely knowledgeable. They guided me through the entire process, helping me choose the right materials and providing a competitive quote.

The quality of their work truly exceeded my expectations. The new roof looks fantastic, and I can already tell it will stand the test of time. Not only did they complete the project on time, but they also cleaned up thoroughly afterward, leaving my property spotless.

What sets R2 Roof Guys apart is their commitment to customer satisfaction. They were always responsive to my questions and concerns, making me feel valued as a customer. Their attention to detail and dedication to delivering a superior roofing solution is commendable.

I highly recommend R2 Roof Guys to anyone in need of roofing services. They are a trustworthy and reliable company that delivers exceptional results. Thank you, R2 Roof Guys, for transforming my home with a beautiful and durable roof!
reviews.author: Michael Martinez

reviews.text: R2 roofing made the entire process of getting a new roof as easy and hassle free as possible. I found them extremely reasonable and attentive to details and were flexible working around my schedule.
reviews.author: Christopher Rivers

reviews.text: Richard and his crew are fantastic!!! We had a really bad storm out in Josephine and he came out the very next day with his team and replaced shingles that I lost in the storm. I would recommend him to anyone looking for an excellent roofer.
reviews.author: Darren

reviews.text: Richard and his team did an amazing job with our roof replacement. He was upfront and honest and very helpful with the entire process. This was the first time we have had to go through this process, and Richard was nothing but helpful with all of our questions. He is very knowledgeable, helpful, and easy to work with. I would recommend him to anyone needing roof work.
reviews.author: Debra Gilliland

reviews.text: Wonderful service!  Last year they replaced my roof and installed gutters. The entire process beginning to end was easy and quick!  Richard does a great job communicating. This year when I needed to replace my fence I knew exactly who to call and was not disappointed. They did a great job and were done in two days. I cannot recommend them enough. You will not be disappointed!
reviews.author: Laura M

data.summary: The reviews appear largely authentic with specific, varied customer experiences. The perfect 5.0 rating with only 61 reviews over 7 years is slightly unusual but not definitive proof of manipulation. The lack of any negative reviews in the sample and absence of warranty mentions are minor concerns, but the detailed positive reviews are credible.
fake_signals: Some reviews lack specific project details (e.g., Michael Martinez, Christopher Rivers)
Low total review count (61) for a 7-year-old business
authentic_signals: Specific details in most reviews (patio cover, gutters, painters named Roberto, decking/rafter issues)
Mentions of specific timelines and weather challenges
Owner (Richard) is consistently named and praised for communication
data.discrepancy_explanation: No contradictory ratings found. Google shows perfect 5.0, BBB shows A+ with accreditation. Yelp and other platforms show no reviews or ratings to compare.
